events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare live plists to repo copies, scan for secrets, check remotes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md workshop-plan/ops/up.sh; echo ---LIVE; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -c . ; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents; echo ---DIFF; for f in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist; do b=$(basename $f); r=$(ls workshop-plan/ops/$b workshop-plan/ops/launchd/$b 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$r" ]; then echo "NOCOPY $b"; elif ! cmp -s $f $r; then echo "DIFFERS $b"; fi; done; echo ---REPO-ONLY; for r in workshop-plan/ops/*.plist workshop-plan/ops/launchd/*.plist; do [ -f ~/Library/LaunchAgents/$(basename $r) ] || echo "repo-only $r"; done
